name: vermis mentis : mental virus
source:
Arlet doesn’t want to be lonely. No one wants to be lonely. Will drugs help her? The blister packs crinkle in her hands.

And then, a girl appears. Naked, freshly born. Mika.

The story follows these two girls as they form a connection, and find out just what exactly this connection is.

[From [url=https://dew-xx.itch.io/vermis-mentis-mental-virus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿莱特不想孤独一人。没有人愿意孤独一人。药物能帮到她吗？铝塑药板在她掌心发出窸窣脆响。

就在这时，一名少女出现了。一丝不挂，宛如初生。她叫米卡。

故事围绕这两名少女建立起联结，并一步步查明这段联结究竟意味着什么展开。

[摘自[url=https://dew-xx.itch.io/vermis-mentis-mental-virus]itch.io[/url]]
